query: Review evals/fixture.tsx against the Web Interface Guidelines. Report only, do not edit.
expected_behavior: Reads the pinned reference before reviewing and does not fetch the guidelines from the network.
Groups findings by file with exact file:line references.
Flags the icon-only button without aria-label, the unlabeled input, the clickable div, the image without alt or dimensions, and transition: all.
Labels any Vercel or React house-style finding as advisory rather than blocking.
Does not edit the fixture and ends with a one-line review summary.
baseline_failure: Without the skill, the model rewrites the component or gives generic accessibility advice without line references.
